items.label: County
items.text: Montgomery County is 507 square miles with over 1 million residents. The county is divided into six police districts.

items.label: Sectors
items.text: Each district is divided into sectors.

items.label: Beats
items.text: Each beat (response area) is comprised of PRAs (atoms).

items.label: PRAs
items.text: Reporting districts which break down each beat and sector for statistical purposes and for future determination of sector or response area realignment.

items.label: CL
items.text: Corporate Limits or City Limits. Used to determine dispatch responses and for statistical purposes like the atoms.

items.label: Municipalities
items.text: Three municipalities affect response areas: Rockville City, Chevy Chase Village, and Gaithersburg City.

items.label: First digit
items.text: A number between 1 and 9 for patrol. Corresponds with the shift or squad number the officer is assigned. The number has nothing to do with the district they are assigned.

items.label: Second digit
items.text: A letter which corresponds to the district the officer is assigned.

items.label: Third digit
items.text: Represents the response area (beat) that the officer is assigned.

items.label: Fourth digit
items.text: Represents the number of units in that particular response area (beat), starting with “2”.

items.label: Sergeant
items.text: A car (unit) number with a “0” on the end indicates a Sergeant. Example: 1A10.

items.label: Corporal
items.text: A car (unit) number with “11” on the end indicates a Corporal. Example: 1A11.

sections.heading: Phonetics
sections.text:
Always use the phonetic alphabet when calling a car (unit).
Example: 2D1 = Two Delta One.
